+        "checkpoint_finalizer_sha256": receipt["validator_source_hashes"]["checkpoint_finalizer_sha256"],
+        "evaluated_keys_canonical_json_sha256": receipt["schema_hashes"]["evaluated_keys_canonical_json_sha256"],
+        "execution_dependency_sha256": receipt["runner"]["execution_dependency_sha256"],
+    }
+    if observed != expected or expected["runner_sha256"] != PREDECESSOR_RUNNER_SHA256:
+        raise RuntimeError("pre_selection_component_hash_drift_global_stop")
+    if expected["test_sha256"] != PREDECESSOR_TEST_SHA256:
+        raise RuntimeError("predecessor_test_hash_drift_global_stop")
+    return receipt
+
+
+def paper_metadata(paper_id: str) -> tuple[str, int, int, int]:
+    match = re.fullmatch(r"9709_([msw])(\d\d)_qp_([1-6])(\d)", paper_id)
+    if not match:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"paper_identity_invalid_global_stop:{paper_id}")
+    session, year, component, variant = match.groups()
+    return session, 2000 + int(year), int(component), int(variant)
+
+
+def surface_manifest_path(paper_id: str) -> Path:
+    session, year, component, _ = paper_metadata(paper_id)
+    if year == 2025:
+        return REPO / f"data/manifests/9709_p{component}_{session}25_standard_001_page_chain_surface_v2.json"
+    return REPO / f"data/manifests/9709_p{component}_{session}_standard_001_page_chain_surface_v1.json"
+
+
+def prior_membership() -> tuple[set[str], dict[str, Any]]:
+    combined: list[str] = []
+    sources = []
+    for path, key, expected_count in PRIOR_SOURCES:
+        rows = read_json(path).get(key)
+        if not isinstance(rows, list):
+            raise RuntimeError(f"prior_membership_rows_invalid_global_stop:{path.name}")
+        ids = [row.get("question_id") for row in rows]
+        if len(ids) != expected_count or any(not isinstance(value, str) or not value for value in ids):
+            raise RuntimeError(f"prior_membership_count_invalid_global_stop:{path.name}")
+        if len(ids) != len(set(ids)):
+            raise RuntimeError(f"prior_membership_duplicates_global_stop:{path.name}")
+        combined.extend(ids)
+        sources.append({
+            "path": path.relative_to(REPO).as_posix(),
+            "sha256": sha256_file(path),
+            "question_count": expected_count,
+            "question_ids_sha256": sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(ids)),
+        })
+    if len(combined) != 213 or len(set(combined)) != 213:
+        raise RuntimeError("combined_prior_membership_invalid_global_stop")
+    return set(combined), {
+        "question_count": 213,
+        "question_ids_sha256": sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(combined)),
+        "sources": sources,
+    }
+
+
+def population() -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, Any]]:
+    prior_ids, prior_receipt = prior_membership()
+    papers: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    source_inventory: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
+    overlap: list[str] = []
+    for paper_id in PAPERS:
+        manifest_path = surface_manifest_path(paper_id)
+        source_inventory.setdefault(manifest_path.as_posix(), {
+            "path": manifest_path.relative_to(REPO).as_posix(),
+            "sha256": sha256_file(manifest_path),
+        })
+        items = [
+            item for item in read_json(manifest_path).get("items", [])
+            if Path(str(item.get("source_pdf", ""))).stem == paper_id
+        ]
+        items.sort(key=lambda item: item.get("q_number", 0))
+        numbers = [item.get("q_number") for item in items]
+        if not numbers or numbers != list(range(1, max(numbers) + 1)):
+            raise RuntimeError(f"complete_paper_membership_invalid_global_stop:{paper_id}")
+        source_paths = {item.get("source_pdf") for item in items}
+        if len(source_paths) != 1:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"paper_source_ambiguous_global_stop:{paper_id}")
+        source_relative = next(iter(source_paths))
+        source_pdf = REPO / str(source_relative)
+        if not source_pdf.is_file() or source_pdf.name.startswith("WM_"):
+            raise RuntimeError(f"official_source_missing_global_stop:{paper_id}")
+        session, year, component, variant = paper_metadata(paper_id)
+        papers.append({
+            "paper_id": paper_id,
+            "component": f"P{component}",
+            "session": session,
+            "year": year,
+            "variant": variant,
+            "source_path": str(source_relative),
+            "official_public_source_posture": "repository_official_pdf_bytes",
+            "pdf_sha256": sha256_file(source_pdf),
+            "question_count": len(items),
+            "selection_posture": "complete_official_public_paper",
+        })
+        for item in items:
+            question_id = f"{paper_id}_q{item['q_number']:02d}"
+            if question_id in prior_ids:
+                overlap.append(question_id)
+            rows.append({
+                "question_id": question_id,
+                "paper_id": paper_id,
+                "question_number": item["q_number"],
+                "source_pdf": str(source_relative),
+                "surface_manifest": manifest_path.relative_to(REPO).as_posix(),
+                "surface_storage_key": item.get("storage_key"),
+                "navigation_page_indices": navigation_page_indices(item),
+            })
+    component_counts = Counter(paper["component"] for paper in papers)
+    session_counts = Counter(paper["session"] for paper in papers)
+    year_counts = Counter(str(paper["year"]) for paper in papers)
+    if overlap:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"prior_overlap_global_stop:{','.join(overlap)}")
+    if len(rows) < 200 or len(set(row["question_id"] for row in rows)) != len(rows):
+        raise RuntimeError("holdout_question_floor_or_uniqueness_failed_global_stop")
+    if set(component_counts) != {f"P{number}" for number in range(1, 7)}:
+        raise RuntimeError("paper_component_coverage_failed_global_stop")
+    if len(session_counts) < 3 or len(year_counts) < 3:
+        raise RuntimeError("session_year_breadth_failed_global_stop")
+    return papers, rows, {
+        "paper_count": len(papers),
+        "question_count": len(rows),
+        "paper_family_counts": dict(sorted(component_counts.items())),
+        "session_counts": dict(sorted(session_counts.items())),
+        "year_counts": dict(sorted(year_counts.items())),
+        "source_surface_manifests": sorted(source_inventory.values(), key=lambda row: row["path"]),
+        "prior_membership": prior_receipt,
+        "exact_question_id_overlap_with_prior_213": 0,
+        "exact_overlap_question_ids": [],
+    }
+
+
+def navigation_page_indices(item: dict[str, Any]) -> list[int]:
+    records = item.get("crop_records")
+    if isinstance(records, list) and records:
+        values = [record.get("page_index") for record in records]
+    else:
+        paths = item.get("source_rendered_page_paths")
+        if not isinstance(paths, list) or not paths:
+            raise RuntimeError("navigation_page_chain_missing_global_stop")
+        values = []
+        for value in paths:
+            match = PAGE_RE.search(str(value))
+            if not match:
+                raise RuntimeError("navigation_page_path_invalid_global_stop")
+            values.append(int(match.group(1)) - 1)
+    if any(type(value) is not int or value < 0 for value in values):
+        raise RuntimeError("navigation_page_index_invalid_global_stop")
+    if values != sorted(set(values)):
+        raise RuntimeError("navigation_page_chain_order_invalid_global_stop")
+    return values
+
+
+def _pillow() -> tuple[Any, Any, Any]:
+    from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
+    return Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
+
+
+def _fitz() -> Any:
+    import fitz
+    return fitz
+
+
+def question_headers(document: Any, max_question: int) -> dict[int, tuple[int, float]]:
+    headers: dict[int, tuple[int, float]] = {}
+    duplicates: set[int] = set()
+    for page_index, page in enumerate(document):
+        for word in page.get_text("words"):
+            x0, y0, _x1, _y1, text, *_ = word
+            if not 35 <= x0 < 70 or y0 >= 790 or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]+", str(text)):
+                continue
+            number = int(text)
+            if not 1 <= number <= max_question:
+                continue
+            if number in headers:
+                duplicates.add(number)
+            else:
+                headers[number] = (page_index, float(y0))
+    expected = set(range(1, max_question + 1))
+    if duplicates or set(headers) != expected:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            "authoritative_question_headers_ambiguous_global_stop:"
+            f"{Path(document.name).stem}:duplicates={sorted(duplicates)}:"
+            f"missing={sorted(expected - set(headers))}:extra={sorted(set(headers) - expected)}"
+        )
+    ordered = [headers[number] for number in range(1, max_question + 1)]
+    if ordered != sorted(ordered):
+        raise RuntimeError("authoritative_question_headers_out_of_order_global_stop")
+    return headers
+
+
+def render_and_extract(
+    row: dict[str, Any], paper_count: int, freeze_root: Path
+) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, Any], list[int]]:
+    fitz = _fitz()
+    source_pdf = REPO / row["source_pdf"]
+    question_number = row["question_number"]
+    regions: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    label_events: list[tuple[int, float, float, str]] = []
+    mark_events: list[tuple[int, float, float, int]] = []
+    current_parent: str | None = None
+    with fitz.open(str(source_pdf)) as document:
+        headers = question_headers(document, paper_count)
+        start_page, start_y = headers[question_number]
+        next_header = headers.get(question_number + 1)
+        navigation_pages = row["navigation_page_indices"]
+        if start_page != navigation_pages[0]:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"navigation_start_page_mismatch_global_stop:{row['question_id']}")
+        if next_header:
+            next_page, next_y = next_header
+            last_page = next_page - 1 if next_page > start_page and next_y < 120 else next_page
+            pages = list(range(start_page, last_page + 1))
+        else:
+            last_mark_pages = [
+                page_index
+                for page_index in range(start_page, len(document))
+                if any(MARK_RE.fullmatch(str(word[4])) for word in document[page_index].get_text("words"))
+            ]
+            if not last_mark_pages:
+                raise RuntimeError(f"last_question_authoritative_end_missing_global_stop:{row['question_id']}")
+            pages = list(range(start_page, max(last_mark_pages) + 1))
+        pages = [
+            page_index for page_index in pages
+            if "BLANK PAGE" not in document[page_index].get_text().upper()
+        ]
+        if not pages or pages[0] != start_page:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"authoritative_question_pages_invalid_global_stop:{row['question_id']}")
+        for ordinal, page_index in enumerate(pages, 1):
+            page = document[page_index]
+            top = max(42.0, start_y - 8.0) if page_index == start_page else 42.0
+            bottom = min(float(page.rect.height) - 35.0, 807.0)
+            if next_header and next_header[0] == page_index:
+                bottom = min(bottom, next_header[1] - 8.0)
+            if bottom <= top:
+                raise RuntimeError(f"authoritative_crop_geometry_invalid_global_stop:{row['question_id']}")
+            box = [0.0, round(top, 3), round(float(page.rect.width), 3), round(bottom, 3)]
+            pixmap = page.get_pixmap(matrix=fitz.Matrix(2.0, 2.0), clip=fitz.Rect(*box), alpha=False)
+            payload = pixmap.tobytes("png")
+            crop_path = (
+                freeze_root / "crops" / row["paper_id"] / row["question_id"]
+                / f"region-{ordinal:02d}-page-{page_index + 1:02d}.png"
+            )
+            crop_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+            frozen.base.write_once_or_verify(crop_path, payload)
+            regions.append({
+                "region_id": f"{row['question_id']}:region:{ordinal}",
+                "page_number": page_index + 1,
+                "crop_box_pdf_points": box,
+                "crop_external_path": str(crop_path.resolve()),
+                "crop_sha256": sha256_bytes(payload),
+                "render_engine": "PyMuPDF",
+                "render_scale": 2.0,
+            })
+            clip = fitz.Rect(*box)
+            for word in page.get_text("words", clip=clip):
+                x0, y0, _x1, _y1, text, *_ = word
+                label_match = LABEL_RE.fullmatch(str(text))
+                if label_match and x0 < 180:
+                    label = label_match.group(1).lower()
+                    if label in ROMANS and current_parent:
+                        label = f"{current_parent}({label})"
+                    elif label not in ROMANS:
+                        current_parent = label
+                    label_events.append((page_index, float(y0), float(x0), label))
+                mark_match = MARK_RE.fullmatch(str(text))
+                if mark_match:
+                    mark_events.append((page_index, float(y0), float(x0), int(mark_match.group(1))))
+    visible: list[str] = []
+    for *_position, label in label_events:
+        if label not in visible:
+            visible.append(label)
+    marks = []
+    for page_index, y0, x0, value in mark_events:
+        preceding = [
+            event for event in label_events
+            if (event[0], event[1], event[2]) <= (page_index, y0 + 3.0, x0)
+        ]
+        marks.append({"owner": preceding[-1][3] if preceding else "question", "marks": value})
+    leaves = [label for label in visible if not any(other.startswith(label + "(") for other in visible)]
+    expected_owners = leaves if visible else ["question"]
+    if not marks or [mark["owner"] for mark in marks] != expected_owners:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"provisional_truth_owner_structure_ambiguous_global_stop:{row['question_id']}")
+    expected = {
+        "question_number": question_number,
+        "visible_subparts": visible,
+        "visible_marks": marks,
+        "candidate_writing_present": False,
+        "foreign_annotation_present": False,
+    }
+    return regions, expected, pages
+
+
+def build_contact_sheet(paper_id: str, rows: list[dict[str, Any]], output: Path) -> str:
+    Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont = _pillow()
+    font = ImageFont.load_default()
+    panels = []
+    for row in rows:
+        full_image, _ = frozen.build_question_images(row["regions"])
+        with Image.open(io.BytesIO(full_image["bytes"])) as image:
+            panel = image.convert("RGB")
+        if panel.width > 1100:
+            panel = panel.resize((1100, round(panel.height * 1100 / panel.width)))
+        marks = ",".join(f"{item['owner']}={item['marks']}" for item in row["provisional_expected"]["visible_marks"])
+        caption = (
+            f"{row['question_id']} pages={row['complete_page_chain']} "
+            f"parts={row['provisional_expected']['visible_subparts']} marks={marks}"
+        )
+        canvas = Image.new("RGB", (max(1100, panel.width), panel.height + 42), "white")
+        ImageDraw.Draw(canvas).text((8, 8), caption, fill="black", font=font)
+        canvas.paste(panel, (0, 42))
+        panels.append(canvas)
+    sheet = Image.new("RGB", (max(panel.width for panel in panels), sum(panel.height for panel in panels)), "white")
+    y = 0
+    for panel in panels:
+        sheet.paste(panel, (0, y))
+        y += panel.height
+    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    sheet.save(output, format="PNG", optimize=True)
+    return sha256_file(output)
+
+
+def prepare_review(args: argparse.Namespace) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    verify_component_freeze()
+    papers, population_rows, source = population()
+    freeze_root = (args.run_root / "frozen-inputs").resolve()
+    by_paper_count = {paper["paper_id"]: paper["question_count"] for paper in papers}
+    review_rows = []
+    for row in population_rows:
+        regions, expected, authoritative_pages = render_and_extract(
+            row, by_paper_count[row["paper_id"]], freeze_root
+        )
+        review_rows.append({
+            **row,
+            "complete_page_chain": [region["page_number"] for region in regions],
+            "authoritative_page_indices": authoritative_pages,
+            "navigation_page_chain_match": authoritative_pages == row["navigation_page_indices"],
+            "regions": regions,
+            "provisional_expected": expected,
+            "review_status": "pending_codex_visual_review",
+        })
+    sheets = []
+    for paper in papers:
+        paper_rows = [row for row in review_rows if row["paper_id"] == paper["paper_id"]]
+        visible_mark_total = sum(
+            mark["marks"]
+            for row in paper_rows
+            for mark in row["provisional_expected"]["visible_marks"]
+        )
+        expected_total = 75 if paper["component"] in {"P1", "P3"} else 50
+        if visible_mark_total != expected_total:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                f"authoritative_whole_paper_mark_total_mismatch_global_stop:"
+                f"{paper['paper_id']}:{visible_mark_total}!={expected_total}"
+            )
+        paper["authoritative_visible_mark_total"] = visible_mark_total
+        paper["authoritative_page_chain_validation_status"] = "complete"
+        path = (args.run_root / "review-sheets" / f"{paper['paper_id']}.png").resolve()
+        sheets.append({
+            "paper_id": paper["paper_id"], "path": str(path),
+            "sha256": build_contact_sheet(paper["paper_id"], paper_rows, path),
+            "question_count": len(paper_rows),
+        })
+    payload = {
+        "schema_version": "9709_local_vlm_holdout_visual_review_draft_v1",
+        "issue": ISSUE,
+        "candidate_responses_used": False,
+        "provider_call_count": 0,
+        "base_sha": REQUIRED_BASE_SHA,
+        "component_freeze_sha256": sha256_file(COMPONENT_FREEZE),
+        "render_library_versions": render_library_versions(),
+        "source": source,
+        "papers": papers,
+        "review_sheets": sheets,
+        "rows": review_rows,
+    }
+    write_json(args.review_draft, payload)
+    return {
+        "status": "awaiting_candidate_blind_visual_review",
+        "review_draft": str(args.review_draft),
+        "review_draft_sha256": sha256_file(args.review_draft),
+        "paper_count": len(papers), "question_count": len(review_rows),
+        "prior_overlap": 0, "provider_calls": 0,
+    }
+
+
+def render_library_versions() -> dict[str, str]:
+    fitz = _fitz()
+    Image, _ImageDraw, _ImageFont = _pillow()
+    import PIL
+    return {"PyMuPDF": str(fitz.VersionBind), "Pillow": str(PIL.__version__), "image_module": str(Image.__name__)}
+
+
+def accept_review(args: argparse.Namespace) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    verify_component_freeze()
+    if args.confirm != "authoritative-full-page-chains-inspected":
+        raise RuntimeError("visual_review_confirmation_missing_global_stop")
+    if sha256_file(args.review_draft) != args.review_draft_sha256:
+        raise RuntimeError("visual_review_draft_hash_mismatch_global_stop")
+    draft = read_json(args.review_draft)
+    papers, population_rows, source = population()
+    if (
+        draft.get("base_sha") != REQUIRED_BASE_SHA
+        or draft.get("candidate_responses_used") is not False
+        or draft.get("provider_call_count") != 0
+        or draft.get("source") != source
+        or [paper["paper_id"] for paper in draft.get("papers", [])] != [paper["paper_id"] for paper in papers]
+    ):
+        raise RuntimeError("visual_review_draft_provenance_invalid_global_stop")
+    population_index = frozen.index_rows(population_rows, "question_id", "review_population")
+    draft_index = frozen.index_rows(draft.get("rows"), "question_id", "review_draft")
+    if set(draft_index) != set(population_index):
+        raise RuntimeError("visual_review_draft_membership_invalid_global_stop")
+    for row in draft_index.values():
+        if row.get("review_status") != "pending_codex_visual_review":
+            raise RuntimeError(f"visual_review_draft_status_invalid_global_stop:{row['question_id']}")
+        if row.get("complete_page_chain") != [region.get("page_number") for region in row.get("regions", [])]:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"visual_review_draft_page_chain_invalid_global_stop:{row['question_id']}")
+        for region in row["regions"]:
+            crop = Path(region["crop_external_path"])
+            if not crop.is_file() or sha256_file(crop) != region["crop_sha256"]:
+                raise RuntimeError(f"visual_review_draft_crop_hash_mismatch_global_stop:{row['question_id']}")
+        validate_expected(row.get("provisional_expected"), row["question_number"], row["question_id"])
+    if any(paper.get("authoritative_page_chain_validation_status") != "complete" for paper in draft["papers"]):
+        raise RuntimeError("visual_review_draft_incomplete_paper_global_stop")
+    overrides = read_json(args.overrides) if args.overrides else {"overrides": []}
+    indexed_overrides = frozen.index_rows(overrides.get("overrides", []), "question_id", "truth_override")
+    rows = []
+    for row in draft.get("rows", []):
+        correction = indexed_overrides.get(row["question_id"])
+        expected = correction["expected"] if correction else row["provisional_expected"]
+        rows.append({
+            **row,
+            "expected": expected,
+            "review_status": "accepted_codex_candidate_blind_visual_review",
+            "review_method": "direct_visual_inspection_of_fresh_authoritative_complete_page_chain",
+            "truth_override_applied": correction is not None,
+        })
+        rows[-1].pop("provisional_expected", None)
+    if set(indexed_overrides) - {row["question_id"] for row in rows}:
+        raise RuntimeError("foreign_truth_override_global_stop")
+    accepted = {
+        "schema_version": "9709_local_vlm_holdout_candidate_blind_visual_review_v1",
+        "issue": ISSUE,
+        "frozen_before_provider_calls": True,
+        "candidate_responses_used": False,
+        "provider_call_count": 0,
+        "reviewer": "codex_visual_review",
+        "review_confirmation": args.confirm,
+        "source_review_draft_sha256": args.review_draft_sha256,
+        "override_source": ({
+            "path": args.overrides.relative_to(REPO).as_posix(), "sha256": sha256_file(args.overrides),
+            "count": len(indexed_overrides),
+        } if args.overrides else {"path": None, "sha256": None, "count": 0}),
+        "render_library_versions": draft["render_library_versions"],
+        "source": draft["source"],
+        "papers": draft["papers"],
+        "review_sheets": draft["review_sheets"],
+        "rows": rows,
+    }
+    write_json(args.review, accepted)
body: Valid high-severity freeze hardening, recorded as `write-once-freeze-outputs`. Historical integrity is preserved by observed evidence: review, truth, manifest, runner, prompt, normalization, merge, and validator hashes changed zero times after the first response. Applying write-once semantics now would alter the frozen harness after 249 responses, forbidden by #1635. The mandatory successor will implement write-once-or-byte-identical behavior for accepted review, truth, and manifest outputs.

+rendering, candidate-blind truth review, immutable bindings, checkpointed

+def question_headers(document: Any, max_question: int) -> dict[int, tuple[int, float]]:
+    headers: dict[int, tuple[int, float]] = {}
+    duplicates: set[int] = set()
+    for page_index, page in enumerate(document):
+        for word in page.get_text("words"):
+            x0, y0, _x1, _y1, text, *_ = word
+            if not 35 <= x0 < 70 or y0 >= 790 or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]+", str(text)):
+                continue
+            number = int(text)
+            if not 1 <= number <= max_question:
+                continue
+            if number in headers:
+                duplicates.add(number)
+            else:
+                headers[number] = (page_index, float(y0))
+    expected = set(range(1, max_question + 1))
+    if duplicates or set(headers) != expected:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            "authoritative_question_headers_ambiguous_global_stop:"
+            f"{Path(document.name).stem}:duplicates={sorted(duplicates)}:"
+            f"missing={sorted(expected - set(headers))}:extra={sorted(set(headers) - expected)}"
+        )
+    ordered = [headers[number] for number in range(1, max_question + 1)]
+    if ordered != sorted(ordered):
+        raise RuntimeError("authoritative_question_headers_out_of_order_global_stop")
+    return headers

+def render_and_extract(
+    row: dict[str, Any], paper_count: int, freeze_root: Path
+) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, Any], list[int]]:
+    fitz = _fitz()
+    source_pdf = REPO / row["source_pdf"]
+    question_number = row["question_number"]
+    regions: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    label_events: list[tuple[int, float, float, str]] = []
+    mark_events: list[tuple[int, float, float, int]] = []
+    current_parent: str | None = None
+    with fitz.open(str(source_pdf)) as document:
+        headers = question_headers(document, paper_count)
+        start_page, start_y = headers[question_number]
+        next_header = headers.get(question_number + 1)
+        navigation_pages = row["navigation_page_indices"]
+        if start_page != navigation_pages[0]:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"navigation_start_page_mismatch_global_stop:{row['question_id']}")
+        if next_header:
+            next_page, next_y = next_header
+            last_page = next_page - 1 if next_page > start_page and next_y < 120 else next_page
+            pages = list(range(start_page, last_page + 1))
+        else:
+            last_mark_pages = [
+                page_index
+                for page_index in range(start_page, len(document))
+                if any(MARK_RE.fullmatch(str(word[4])) for word in document[page_index].get_text("words"))
+            ]
+            if not last_mark_pages:
+                raise RuntimeError(f"last_question_authoritative_end_missing_global_stop:{row['question_id']}")
+            pages = list(range(start_page, max(last_mark_pages) + 1))
+        pages = [
+            page_index for page_index in pages
+            if "BLANK PAGE" not in document[page_index].get_text().upper()
+        ]
+        if not pages or pages[0] != start_page:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"authoritative_question_pages_invalid_global_stop:{row['question_id']}")
+        for ordinal, page_index in enumerate(pages, 1):
+            page = document[page_index]
+            top = max(42.0, start_y - 8.0) if page_index == start_page else 42.0
+            bottom = min(float(page.rect.height) - 35.0, 807.0)
+            if next_header and next_header[0] == page_index:
+                bottom = min(bottom, next_header[1] - 8.0)
+            if bottom <= top:
+                raise RuntimeError(f"authoritative_crop_geometry_invalid_global_stop:{row['question_id']}")
+            box = [0.0, round(top, 3), round(float(page.rect.width), 3), round(bottom, 3)]
+            pixmap = page.get_pixmap(matrix=fitz.Matrix(2.0, 2.0), clip=fitz.Rect(*box), alpha=False)
+            payload = pixmap.tobytes("png")
+            crop_path = (
+                freeze_root / "crops" / row["paper_id"] / row["question_id"]
+                / f"region-{ordinal:02d}-page-{page_index + 1:02d}.png"
+            )
+            crop_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+            frozen.base.write_once_or_verify(crop_path, payload)
+            regions.append({
+                "region_id": f"{row['question_id']}:region:{ordinal}",
+                "page_number": page_index + 1,
+                "crop_box_pdf_points": box,
+                "crop_external_path": str(crop_path.resolve()),
+                "crop_sha256": sha256_bytes(payload),
+                "render_engine": "PyMuPDF",
+                "render_scale": 2.0,
+            })
+            clip = fitz.Rect(*box)
+            for word in page.get_text("words", clip=clip):
+                x0, y0, _x1, _y1, text, *_ = word
+                label_match = LABEL_RE.fullmatch(str(text))
+                if label_match and x0 < 180:
+                    label = label_match.group(1).lower()
+                    if label in ROMANS and current_parent:
+                        label = f"{current_parent}({label})"
+                    elif label not in ROMANS:
+                        current_parent = label
+                    label_events.append((page_index, float(y0), float(x0), label))
+                mark_match = MARK_RE.fullmatch(str(text))
+                if mark_match:
+                    mark_events.append((page_index, float(y0), float(x0), int(mark_match.group(1))))
+    visible: list[str] = []
+    for *_position, label in label_events:
+        if label not in visible:
+            visible.append(label)
+    marks = []
+    for page_index, y0, x0, value in mark_events:
+        preceding = [
+            event for event in label_events
+            if (event[0], event[1], event[2]) <= (page_index, y0 + 3.0, x0)
+        ]
+        marks.append({"owner": preceding[-1][3] if preceding else "question", "marks": value})
+    leaves = [label for label in visible if not any(other.startswith(label + "(") for other in visible)]
+    expected_owners = leaves if visible else ["question"]
+    if not marks or [mark["owner"] for mark in marks] != expected_owners:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"provisional_truth_owner_structure_ambiguous_global_stop:{row['question_id']}")
+    expected = {
+        "question_number": question_number,
+        "visible_subparts": visible,
+        "visible_marks": marks,
+        "candidate_writing_present": False,
+        "foreign_annotation_present": False,
+    }
+    return regions, expected, pages

+        with Image.open(io.BytesIO(full_image["bytes"])) as image:

+        if panel.width > 1100:

+    y = 0

+def prior_membership() -> tuple[set[str], dict[str, Any]]:
+    combined: list[str] = []

+    for path, key, expected_count in PRIOR_SOURCES:
+        rows = read_json(path).get(key)

+            raise RuntimeError(f"prior_membership_rows_invalid_global_stop:{path.name}")

+        if len(ids) != expected_count or any(not isinstance(value, str) or not value for value in ids):
+            raise RuntimeError(f"prior_membership_count_invalid_global_stop:{path.name}")
+        if len(ids) != len(set(ids)):
+            raise RuntimeError(f"prior_membership_duplicates_global_stop:{path.name}")
+        combined.extend(ids)
+        sources.append({
+            "path": path.relative_to(REPO).as_posix(),
+            "sha256": sha256_file(path),
+            "question_count": expected_count,
+            "question_ids_sha256": sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(ids)),
+        })

+        raise RuntimeError("combined_prior_membership_invalid_global_stop")

+def population() -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, Any]]:

+    papers: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

+    overlap: list[str] = []
+    for paper_id in PAPERS:

+        items = [
+            item for item in read_json(manifest_path).get("items", [])

+        ]
+        items.sort(key=lambda item: item.get("q_number", 0))

+            raise RuntimeError(f"official_source_missing_global_stop:{paper_id}")

+            "variant": variant,
+            "source_path": str(source_relative),

+            "pdf_sha256": sha256_file(source_pdf),

+                "surface_storage_key": item.get("storage_key"),
+                "navigation_page_indices": navigation_page_indices(item),

+def navigation_page_indices(item: dict[str, Any]) -> list[int]:
+    records = item.get("crop_records")
+    if isinstance(records, list) and records:
+        values = [record.get("page_index") for record in records]
+    else:
+        paths = item.get("source_rendered_page_paths")
+        if not isinstance(paths, list) or not paths:
+            raise RuntimeError("navigation_page_chain_missing_global_stop")
+        values = []
+        for value in paths:
+            match = PAGE_RE.search(str(value))
+            if not match:
+                raise RuntimeError("navigation_page_path_invalid_global_stop")
+            values.append(int(match.group(1)) - 1)
+    if any(type(value) is not int or value < 0 for value in values):
+        raise RuntimeError("navigation_page_index_invalid_global_stop")
+    if values != sorted(set(values)):
+        raise RuntimeError("navigation_page_chain_order_invalid_global_stop")

+def question_headers(document: Any, max_question: int) -> dict[int, tuple[int, float]]:
+    headers: dict[int, tuple[int, float]] = {}
+    duplicates: set[int] = set()
+    for page_index, page in enumerate(document):
+        for word in page.get_text("words"):
+            x0, y0, _x1, _y1, text, *_ = word
+            if not 35 <= x0 < 70 or y0 >= 790 or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]+", str(text)):
+                continue
+            number = int(text)
+            if not 1 <= number <= max_question:
+                continue
+            if number in headers:
+                duplicates.add(number)
+            else:
+                headers[number] = (page_index, float(y0))
+    expected = set(range(1, max_question + 1))
+    if duplicates or set(headers) != expected:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            "authoritative_question_headers_ambiguous_global_stop:"
+            f"{Path(document.name).stem}:duplicates={sorted(duplicates)}:"
+            f"missing={sorted(expected - set(headers))}:extra={sorted(set(headers) - expected)}"
+        )
+    ordered = [headers[number] for number in range(1, max_question + 1)]
+    if ordered != sorted(ordered):
+        raise RuntimeError("authoritative_question_headers_out_of_order_global_stop")
+    return headers

+def render_and_extract(
+    row: dict[str, Any], paper_count: int, freeze_root: Path
+) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, Any], list[int]]:
+    fitz = _fitz()
+    source_pdf = REPO / row["source_pdf"]
+    question_number = row["question_number"]
+    regions: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    label_events: list[tuple[int, float, float, str]] = []
+    mark_events: list[tuple[int, float, float, int]] = []
+    current_parent: str | None = None
+    with fitz.open(str(source_pdf)) as document:
+        headers = question_headers(document, paper_count)
+        start_page, start_y = headers[question_number]
+        next_header = headers.get(question_number + 1)
+        navigation_pages = row["navigation_page_indices"]
+        if start_page != navigation_pages[0]:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"navigation_start_page_mismatch_global_stop:{row['question_id']}")
+        if next_header:
+            next_page, next_y = next_header
+            last_page = next_page - 1 if next_page > start_page and next_y < 120 else next_page
+            pages = list(range(start_page, last_page + 1))
+        else:
+            last_mark_pages = [
+                page_index
+                for page_index in range(start_page, len(document))
+                if any(MARK_RE.fullmatch(str(word[4])) for word in document[page_index].get_text("words"))
+            ]
+            if not last_mark_pages:
+                raise RuntimeError(f"last_question_authoritative_end_missing_global_stop:{row['question_id']}")
+            pages = list(range(start_page, max(last_mark_pages) + 1))
+        pages = [
+            page_index for page_index in pages
+            if "BLANK PAGE" not in document[page_index].get_text().upper()
+        ]
+        if not pages or pages[0] != start_page:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"authoritative_question_pages_invalid_global_stop:{row['question_id']}")
+        for ordinal, page_index in enumerate(pages, 1):
+            page = document[page_index]
+            top = max(42.0, start_y - 8.0) if page_index == start_page else 42.0
+            bottom = min(float(page.rect.height) - 35.0, 807.0)
+            if next_header and next_header[0] == page_index:
+                bottom = min(bottom, next_header[1] - 8.0)
+            if bottom <= top:
+                raise RuntimeError(f"authoritative_crop_geometry_invalid_global_stop:{row['question_id']}")
+            box = [0.0, round(top, 3), round(float(page.rect.width), 3), round(bottom, 3)]
+            pixmap = page.get_pixmap(matrix=fitz.Matrix(2.0, 2.0), clip=fitz.Rect(*box), alpha=False)
+            payload = pixmap.tobytes("png")
+            crop_path = (
+                freeze_root / "crops" / row["paper_id"] / row["question_id"]
+                / f"region-{ordinal:02d}-page-{page_index + 1:02d}.png"
+            )
+            crop_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+            frozen.base.write_once_or_verify(crop_path, payload)
+            regions.append({
+                "region_id": f"{row['question_id']}:region:{ordinal}",
+                "page_number": page_index + 1,
+                "crop_box_pdf_points": box,
+                "crop_external_path": str(crop_path.resolve()),
+                "crop_sha256": sha256_bytes(payload),
+                "render_engine": "PyMuPDF",
+                "render_scale": 2.0,
+            })
+            clip = fitz.Rect(*box)
+            for word in page.get_text("words", clip=clip):
+                x0, y0, _x1, _y1, text, *_ = word
+                label_match = LABEL_RE.fullmatch(str(text))
+                if label_match and x0 < 180:
+                    label = label_match.group(1).lower()
+                    if label in ROMANS and current_parent:
+                        label = f"{current_parent}({label})"
+                    elif label not in ROMANS:
+                        current_parent = label
+                    label_events.append((page_index, float(y0), float(x0), label))
+                mark_match = MARK_RE.fullmatch(str(text))
+                if mark_match:
+                    mark_events.append((page_index, float(y0), float(x0), int(mark_match.group(1))))
+    visible: list[str] = []
+    for *_position, label in label_events:
+        if label not in visible:
+            visible.append(label)
+    marks = []
+    for page_index, y0, x0, value in mark_events:
+        preceding = [
+            event for event in label_events
+            if (event[0], event[1], event[2]) <= (page_index, y0 + 3.0, x0)
+        ]
+        marks.append({"owner": preceding[-1][3] if preceding else "question", "marks": value})
+    leaves = [label for label in visible if not any(other.startswith(label + "(") for other in visible)]
+    expected_owners = leaves if visible else ["question"]
+    if not marks or [mark["owner"] for mark in marks] != expected_owners:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"provisional_truth_owner_structure_ambiguous_global_stop:{row['question_id']}")
+    expected = {
+        "question_number": question_number,
+        "visible_subparts": visible,
+        "visible_marks": marks,
+        "candidate_writing_present": False,
+        "foreign_annotation_present": False,
+    }
+    return regions, expected, pages
+

+def build_contact_sheet(paper_id: str, rows: list[dict[str, Any]], output: Path) -> str:
+    Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont = _pillow()
+    font = ImageFont.load_default()
+    panels = []
+    for row in rows:
+        full_image, _ = frozen.build_question_images(row["regions"])
+        with Image.open(io.BytesIO(full_image["bytes"])) as image:
+            panel = image.convert("RGB")
+        if panel.width > 1100:
+            panel = panel.resize((1100, round(panel.height * 1100 / panel.width)))
+        marks = ",".join(f"{item['owner']}={item['marks']}" for item in row["provisional_expected"]["visible_marks"])
+        caption = (
+            f"{row['question_id']} pages={row['complete_page_chain']} "
+            f"parts={row['provisional_expected']['visible_subparts']} marks={marks}"
+        )
+        canvas = Image.new("RGB", (max(1100, panel.width), panel.height + 42), "white")
+        ImageDraw.Draw(canvas).text((8, 8), caption, fill="black", font=font)
+        canvas.paste(panel, (0, 42))
+        panels.append(canvas)
+    sheet = Image.new("RGB", (max(panel.width for panel in panels), sum(panel.height for panel in panels)), "white")
+    y = 0
+    for panel in panels:
+        sheet.paste(panel, (0, y))
+        y += panel.height
+    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    sheet.save(output, format="PNG", optimize=True)
+    return sha256_file(output)

+def prepare_review(args: argparse.Namespace) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    verify_component_freeze()
+    papers, population_rows, source = population()

+    by_paper_count = {paper["paper_id"]: paper["question_count"] for paper in papers}
+    review_rows = []
+    for row in population_rows:
+        regions, expected, authoritative_pages = render_and_extract(
+            row, by_paper_count[row["paper_id"]], freeze_root
+        )
+        review_rows.append({
+            **row,
+            "complete_page_chain": [region["page_number"] for region in regions],
+            "authoritative_page_indices": authoritative_pages,
+            "navigation_page_chain_match": authoritative_pages == row["navigation_page_indices"],
+            "regions": regions,
+            "provisional_expected": expected,
+            "review_status": "pending_codex_visual_review",
+        })
+    sheets = []
+    for paper in papers:
+        paper_rows = [row for row in review_rows if row["paper_id"] == paper["paper_id"]]
+        visible_mark_total = sum(
+            mark["marks"]
+            for row in paper_rows
+            for mark in row["provisional_expected"]["visible_marks"]
+        )
+        expected_total = 75 if paper["component"] in {"P1", "P3"} else 50
+        if visible_mark_total != expected_total:

+                f"authoritative_whole_paper_mark_total_mismatch_global_stop:"
+                f"{paper['paper_id']}:{visible_mark_total}!={expected_total}"
+            )

+        path = (args.run_root / "review-sheets" / f"{paper['paper_id']}.png").resolve()
+        sheets.append({
+            "paper_id": paper["paper_id"], "path": str(path),
+            "sha256": build_contact_sheet(paper["paper_id"], paper_rows, path),
+            "question_count": len(paper_rows),

+    payload = {
+        "schema_version": "9709_local_vlm_holdout_visual_review_draft_v1",
+        "issue": ISSUE,
+        "candidate_responses_used": False,
+        "provider_call_count": 0,
+        "base_sha": REQUIRED_BASE_SHA,
+        "component_freeze_sha256": sha256_file(COMPONENT_FREEZE),
+        "render_library_versions": render_library_versions(),
+        "source": source,
+        "papers": papers,
+        "review_sheets": sheets,
+        "rows": review_rows,

+    write_json(args.review_draft, payload)
+    return {
+        "status": "awaiting_candidate_blind_visual_review",
+        "review_draft": str(args.review_draft),
+        "review_draft_sha256": sha256_file(args.review_draft),
+        "paper_count": len(papers), "question_count": len(review_rows),
+        "prior_overlap": 0, "provider_calls": 0,

+def accept_review(args: argparse.Namespace) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    verify_component_freeze()
+    if args.confirm != "authoritative-full-page-chains-inspected":
+        raise RuntimeError("visual_review_confirmation_missing_global_stop")
+    if sha256_file(args.review_draft) != args.review_draft_sha256:
+        raise RuntimeError("visual_review_draft_hash_mismatch_global_stop")
+    draft = read_json(args.review_draft)
+    papers, population_rows, source = population()
+    if (
+        draft.get("base_sha") != REQUIRED_BASE_SHA
+        or draft.get("candidate_responses_used") is not False
+        or draft.get("provider_call_count") != 0
+        or draft.get("source") != source
+        or [paper["paper_id"] for paper in draft.get("papers", [])] != [paper["paper_id"] for paper in papers]
+    ):
+        raise RuntimeError("visual_review_draft_provenance_invalid_global_stop")
+    population_index = frozen.index_rows(population_rows, "question_id", "review_population")
+    draft_index = frozen.index_rows(draft.get("rows"), "question_id", "review_draft")
+    if set(draft_index) != set(population_index):
+        raise RuntimeError("visual_review_draft_membership_invalid_global_stop")
+    for row in draft_index.values():
+        if row.get("review_status") != "pending_codex_visual_review":
+            raise RuntimeError(f"visual_review_draft_status_invalid_global_stop:{row['question_id']}")
+        if row.get("complete_page_chain") != [region.get("page_number") for region in row.get("regions", [])]:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"visual_review_draft_page_chain_invalid_global_stop:{row['question_id']}")
+        for region in row["regions"]:
+            crop = Path(region["crop_external_path"])
+            if not crop.is_file() or sha256_file(crop) != region["crop_sha256"]:
+                raise RuntimeError(f"visual_review_draft_crop_hash_mismatch_global_stop:{row['question_id']}")
+        validate_expected(row.get("provisional_expected"), row["question_number"], row["question_id"])
+    if any(paper.get("authoritative_page_chain_validation_status") != "complete" for paper in draft["papers"]):
+        raise RuntimeError("visual_review_draft_incomplete_paper_global_stop")
+    overrides = read_json(args.overrides) if args.overrides else {"overrides": []}
+    indexed_overrides = frozen.index_rows(overrides.get("overrides", []), "question_id", "truth_override")
+    rows = []
+    for row in draft.get("rows", []):
+        correction = indexed_overrides.get(row["question_id"])
+        expected = correction["expected"] if correction else row["provisional_expected"]
+        rows.append({
+            **row,
+            "expected": expected,
+            "review_status": "accepted_codex_candidate_blind_visual_review",
+            "review_method": "direct_visual_inspection_of_fresh_authoritative_complete_page_chain",
+            "truth_override_applied": correction is not None,
+        })

+        raise RuntimeError("foreign_truth_override_global_stop")
+    accepted = {
+        "schema_version": "9709_local_vlm_holdout_candidate_blind_visual_review_v1",
+        "issue": ISSUE,
+        "frozen_before_provider_calls": True,
+        "candidate_responses_used": False,
+        "provider_call_count": 0,
+        "reviewer": "codex_visual_review",
+        "review_confirmation": args.confirm,
+        "source_review_draft_sha256": args.review_draft_sha256,
+        "override_source": ({
+            "path": args.overrides.relative_to(REPO).as_posix(), "sha256": sha256_file(args.overrides),
+            "count": len(indexed_overrides),
+        } if args.overrides else {"path": None, "sha256": None, "count": 0}),
+        "render_library_versions": draft["render_library_versions"],
+        "source": draft["source"],
+        "papers": draft["papers"],
+        "review_sheets": draft["review_sheets"],
+        "rows": rows,
+    }
+    write_json(args.review, accepted)
+    return {
+        "status": "candidate_blind_visual_review_accepted",
+        "review_sha256": sha256_file(args.review),
+        "paper_count": len(accepted["papers"]), "question_count": len(rows),
+        "override_count": len(indexed_overrides), "provider_calls": 0,
+    }

+def validate_expected(expected: Any, question_number: int, question_id: str) -> None:
+    if not isinstance(expected, dict) or set(expected) != {
+        "question_number", "visible_subparts", "visible_marks",
+        "candidate_writing_present", "foreign_annotation_present",
+    }:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"truth_schema_invalid_global_stop:{question_id}")
+    if expected["question_number"] != question_number:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"truth_question_identity_invalid_global_stop:{question_id}")
+    parts = expected["visible_subparts"]
+    marks = expected["visible_marks"]
+    if not isinstance(parts, list) or len(parts) != len(set(parts)) or not isinstance(marks, list) or not marks:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"truth_structure_invalid_global_stop:{question_id}")
+    leaves = [part for part in parts if not any(other.startswith(part + "(") for other in parts)]
+    owners = [row.get("owner") for row in marks if isinstance(row, dict)]
+    if owners != (leaves if parts else ["question"]):
+        raise RuntimeError(f"truth_owner_structure_invalid_global_stop:{question_id}")
+    if any(type(row.get("marks")) is not int or row["marks"] <= 0 for row in marks):
+        raise RuntimeError(f"truth_mark_invalid_global_stop:{question_id}")
+    if expected["candidate_writing_present"] is not False or expected["foreign_annotation_present"] is not False:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"truth_clean_source_scalar_invalid_global_stop:{question_id}")
+
+
+def freeze(args: argparse.Namespace) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    component_receipt = verify_component_freeze()
+    review = read_json(args.review)
+    if review.get("candidate_responses_used") is not False or review.get("provider_call_count") != 0:
+        raise RuntimeError("visual_review_contaminated_global_stop")
+    if any(row.get("review_status") != "accepted_codex_candidate_blind_visual_review" for row in review.get("rows", [])):
+        raise RuntimeError("visual_review_incomplete_global_stop")
+    papers, population_rows, source = population()
+    population_index = frozen.index_rows(population_rows, "question_id", "population")

+LABEL_RE = re.compile(r"^\(([a-h]|i|ii|iii|iv|v|vi)\)$", re.IGNORECASE)
+MARK_RE = re.compile(r"^\[(\d+)\]$")
+PAGE_RE = re.compile(r"_page_(\d+)\.png$")
+ROMANS = {"i", "ii", "iii", "iv", "v", "vi"}
+COMPACT_NAMES = (
+    "validation-summary.v1.json",
+    "candidate-results.v1.json",
+    "residual-review-packet.v1.json",
+    "raw-response-hash-inventory.v1.json",
+)
+
+
+def canonical_bytes(value: Any) -> bytes:
+    return batch.canonical_bytes(value)
+
+
+def sha256_bytes(value: bytes) -> str:
+    return hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest()
+
+
+def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
+    return sha256_bytes(path.read_bytes())
+
+
+def read_json(path: Path) -> Any:
+    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+
+
+def write_json(path: Path, value: Any) -> None:
+    batch.write_json(path, value)
+
+
+def git_value(*args: str) -> str:
+    result = subprocess.run(
+        ["git", *args], cwd=REPO, text=True, capture_output=True, check=True,
+    )
+    return result.stdout.strip()
+
+
+def verify_base() -> None:
+    origin_main = git_value("rev-parse", "origin/main")
+    task_base = git_value("merge-base", "HEAD", "origin/main")
+    if origin_main != REQUIRED_BASE_SHA or task_base != REQUIRED_BASE_SHA:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            "recorded_base_changed_global_stop:"
+            f"origin_main={origin_main}:task_base={task_base}"
+        )
+
+
+def source_hash(function: Any) -> str:
+    return sha256_bytes(inspect.getsource(function).encode())
+
+
+def component_hashes() -> dict[str, Any]:
+    return {
+        "runner_sha256": sha256_file(PREDECESSOR_RUNNER),
+        "test_sha256": sha256_file(PREDECESSOR_TEST),
+        "full_prompt_sha256": sha256_bytes(frozen.FULL_PROMPT_TEMPLATE.encode()),
+        "mark_prompt_sha256": sha256_bytes(frozen.MARK_PROMPT.encode()),
+        "normalization_policy_sha256": source_hash(frozen.normalize_full_candidate),
+        "merge_policy_sha256": source_hash(frozen.merge_mark_pass),
+        "evaluation_policy_sha256": source_hash(frozen.evaluate),
+        "terminal_status_policy_sha256": source_hash(frozen.terminal_status),
+        "terminal_validator_sha256": source_hash(frozen.validate_terminal),
+        "input_validator_sha256": source_hash(frozen.validate_repaired_inputs),
+        "checkpoint_finalizer_sha256": source_hash(frozen.finalize_from_checkpoint),
+        "evaluated_keys_canonical_json_sha256": sha256_bytes(
+            json.dumps(frozen.EVALUATED_KEYS, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode()
+        ),
+        "execution_dependency_sha256": frozen._dependency_hashes(),
+    }
+
+
+def verify_component_freeze() -> dict[str, Any]:
+    verify_base()
+    if not COMPONENT_FREEZE.is_file():
+        raise RuntimeError("pre_selection_component_freeze_missing_global_stop")
+    receipt = read_json(COMPONENT_FREEZE)
+    expected = component_hashes()
+    observed = {
+        "runner_sha256": receipt["runner"]["sha256"],
+        "test_sha256": receipt["validator_source_hashes"]["test_file_sha256"],
+        "full_prompt_sha256": receipt["prompt_hashes"]["full_prompt_template_sha256"],
+        "mark_prompt_sha256": receipt["prompt_hashes"]["mark_prompt_sha256"],
+        "normalization_policy_sha256": receipt["policy_source_hashes"]["normalization_policy_sha256"],
+        "merge_policy_sha256": receipt["policy_source_hashes"]["merge_policy_sha256"],
+        "evaluation_policy_sha256": receipt["policy_source_hashes"]["evaluation_policy_sha256"],
+        "terminal_status_policy_sha256": receipt["policy_source_hashes"]["terminal_status_policy_sha256"],
+        "terminal_validator_sha256": receipt["validator_source_hashes"]["terminal_validator_sha256"],
+        "input_validator_sha256": receipt["validator_source_hashes"]["input_validator_sha256"],
+        "checkpoint_finalizer_sha256": receipt["validator_source_hashes"]["checkpoint_finalizer_sha256"],
+        "evaluated_keys_canonical_json_sha256": receipt["schema_hashes"]["evaluated_keys_canonical_json_sha256"],
+        "execution_dependency_sha256": receipt["runner"]["execution_dependency_sha256"],
+    }
+    if observed != expected or expected["runner_sha256"] != PREDECESSOR_RUNNER_SHA256:
+        raise RuntimeError("pre_selection_component_hash_drift_global_stop")
+    if expected["test_sha256"] != PREDECESSOR_TEST_SHA256:
+        raise RuntimeError("predecessor_test_hash_drift_global_stop")
+    return receipt
+
+
+def paper_metadata(paper_id: str) -> tuple[str, int, int, int]:
+    match = re.fullmatch(r"9709_([msw])(\d\d)_qp_([1-6])(\d)", paper_id)
+    if not match:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"paper_identity_invalid_global_stop:{paper_id}")
+    session, year, component, variant = match.groups()
+    return session, 2000 + int(year), int(component), int(variant)
+
+
+def surface_manifest_path(paper_id: str) -> Path:
+    session, year, component, _ = paper_metadata(paper_id)
+    if year == 2025:
+        return REPO / f"data/manifests/9709_p{component}_{session}25_standard_001_page_chain_surface_v2.json"
+    return REPO / f"data/manifests/9709_p{component}_{session}_standard_001_page_chain_surface_v1.json"
+
+
+def prior_membership() -> tuple[set[str], dict[str, Any]]:
+    combined: list[str] = []
+    sources = []
+    for path, key, expected_count in PRIOR_SOURCES:
+        rows = read_json(path).get(key)
+        if not isinstance(rows, list):
+            raise RuntimeError(f"prior_membership_rows_invalid_global_stop:{path.name}")
+        ids = [row.get("question_id") for row in rows]
+        if len(ids) != expected_count or any(not isinstance(value, str) or not value for value in ids):
+            raise RuntimeError(f"prior_membership_count_invalid_global_stop:{path.name}")
+        if len(ids) != len(set(ids)):
+            raise RuntimeError(f"prior_membership_duplicates_global_stop:{path.name}")
+        combined.extend(ids)
+        sources.append({
+            "path": path.relative_to(REPO).as_posix(),
+            "sha256": sha256_file(path),
+            "question_count": expected_count,
+            "question_ids_sha256": sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(ids)),
+        })
+    if len(combined) != 213 or len(set(combined)) != 213:
+        raise RuntimeError("combined_prior_membership_invalid_global_stop")
+    return set(combined), {
+        "question_count": 213,
+        "question_ids_sha256": sha256_bytes(canonical_bytes(combined)),
+        "sources": sources,
+    }
+
+
+def population() -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, Any]]:
+    prior_ids, prior_receipt = prior_membership()
+    papers: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    source_inventory: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
+    overlap: list[str] = []
+    for paper_id in PAPERS:
+        manifest_path = surface_manifest_path(paper_id)
+        source_inventory.setdefault(manifest_path.as_posix(), {
+            "path": manifest_path.relative_to(REPO).as_posix(),
+            "sha256": sha256_file(manifest_path),
+        })
+        items = [
+            item for item in read_json(manifest_path).get("items", [])
+            if Path(str(item.get("source_pdf", ""))).stem == paper_id
+        ]
+        items.sort(key=lambda item: item.get("q_number", 0))
+        numbers = [item.get("q_number") for item in items]
+        if not numbers or numbers != list(range(1, max(numbers) + 1)):
+            raise RuntimeError(f"complete_paper_membership_invalid_global_stop:{paper_id}")
+        source_paths = {item.get("source_pdf") for item in items}
+        if len(source_paths) != 1:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"paper_source_ambiguous_global_stop:{paper_id}")
+        source_relative = next(iter(source_paths))
+        source_pdf = REPO / str(source_relative)
+        if not source_pdf.is_file() or source_pdf.name.startswith("WM_"):
+            raise RuntimeError(f"official_source_missing_global_stop:{paper_id}")
+        session, year, component, variant = paper_metadata(paper_id)
+        papers.append({
+            "paper_id": paper_id,
+            "component": f"P{component}",
+            "session": session,
+            "year": year,
+            "variant": variant,
+            "source_path": str(source_relative),
+            "official_public_source_posture": "repository_official_pdf_bytes",
+            "pdf_sha256": sha256_file(source_pdf),
+            "question_count": len(items),
+            "selection_posture": "complete_official_public_paper",
+        })
+        for item in items:
+            question_id = f"{paper_id}_q{item['q_number']:02d}"
+            if question_id in prior_ids:
+                overlap.append(question_id)
+            rows.append({
+                "question_id": question_id,
+                "paper_id": paper_id,
+                "question_number": item["q_number"],
+                "source_pdf": str(source_relative),
+                "surface_manifest": manifest_path.relative_to(REPO).as_posix(),
+                "surface_storage_key": item.get("storage_key"),
+                "navigation_page_indices": navigation_page_indices(item),
+            })
+    component_counts = Counter(paper["component"] for paper in papers)
+    session_counts = Counter(paper["session"] for paper in papers)
+    year_counts = Counter(str(paper["year"]) for paper in papers)
+    if overlap:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"prior_overlap_global_stop:{','.join(overlap)}")
+    if len(rows) < 200 or len(set(row["question_id"] for row in rows)) != len(rows):
+        raise RuntimeError("holdout_question_floor_or_uniqueness_failed_global_stop")
+    if set(component_counts) != {f"P{number}" for number in range(1, 7)}:
+        raise RuntimeError("paper_component_coverage_failed_global_stop")
+    if len(session_counts) < 3 or len(year_counts) < 3:
+        raise RuntimeError("session_year_breadth_failed_global_stop")
+    return papers, rows, {
+        "paper_count": len(papers),
+        "question_count": len(rows),
+        "paper_family_counts": dict(sorted(component_counts.items())),
+        "session_counts": dict(sorted(session_counts.items())),
+        "year_counts": dict(sorted(year_counts.items())),
+        "source_surface_manifests": sorted(source_inventory.values(), key=lambda row: row["path"]),
+        "prior_membership": prior_receipt,
+        "exact_question_id_overlap_with_prior_213": 0,
+        "exact_overlap_question_ids": [],
+    }
+
+
+def navigation_page_indices(item: dict[str, Any]) -> list[int]:
+    records = item.get("crop_records")
+    if isinstance(records, list) and records:
+        values = [record.get("page_index") for record in records]
+    else:
+        paths = item.get("source_rendered_page_paths")
+        if not isinstance(paths, list) or not paths:
+            raise RuntimeError("navigation_page_chain_missing_global_stop")
+        values = []
+        for value in paths:
+            match = PAGE_RE.search(str(value))
+            if not match:
+                raise RuntimeError("navigation_page_path_invalid_global_stop")
+            values.append(int(match.group(1)) - 1)
+    if any(type(value) is not int or value < 0 for value in values):
+        raise RuntimeError("navigation_page_index_invalid_global_stop")
+    if values != sorted(set(values)):
+        raise RuntimeError("navigation_page_chain_order_invalid_global_stop")
+    return values
+
+
+def _pillow() -> tuple[Any, Any, Any]:
+    from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
+    return Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
+
+
+def _fitz() -> Any:
+    import fitz
+    return fitz
+
+
+def question_headers(document: Any, max_question: int) -> dict[int, tuple[int, float]]:
+    headers: dict[int, tuple[int, float]] = {}
+    duplicates: set[int] = set()
+    for page_index, page in enumerate(document):
+        for word in page.get_text("words"):
+            x0, y0, _x1, _y1, text, *_ = word
+            if not 35 <= x0 < 70 or y0 >= 790 or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]+", str(text)):
+                continue
+            number = int(text)
+            if not 1 <= number <= max_question:
+                continue
+            if number in headers:
+                duplicates.add(number)
+            else:
+                headers[number] = (page_index, float(y0))
+    expected = set(range(1, max_question + 1))
+    if duplicates or set(headers) != expected:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            "authoritative_question_headers_ambiguous_global_stop:"
+            f"{Path(document.name).stem}:duplicates={sorted(duplicates)}:"
+            f"missing={sorted(expected - set(headers))}:extra={sorted(set(headers) - expected)}"
+        )
+    ordered = [headers[number] for number in range(1, max_question + 1)]
+    if ordered != sorted(ordered):
+        raise RuntimeError("authoritative_question_headers_out_of_order_global_stop")
+    return headers
+
+
+def render_and_extract(
+    row: dict[str, Any], paper_count: int, freeze_root: Path
+) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, Any], list[int]]:
+    fitz = _fitz()
+    source_pdf = REPO / row["source_pdf"]
+    question_number = row["question_number"]
+    regions: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    label_events: list[tuple[int, float, float, str]] = []
+    mark_events: list[tuple[int, float, float, int]] = []
+    current_parent: str | None = None
+    with fitz.open(str(source_pdf)) as document:
+        headers = question_headers(document, paper_count)
+        start_page, start_y = headers[question_number]
+        next_header = headers.get(question_number + 1)
+        navigation_pages = row["navigation_page_indices"]
+        if start_page != navigation_pages[0]:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"navigation_start_page_mismatch_global_stop:{row['question_id']}")
+        if next_header:
+            next_page, next_y = next_header
+            last_page = next_page - 1 if next_page > start_page and next_y < 120 else next_page
+            pages = list(range(start_page, last_page + 1))
+        else:
+            last_mark_pages = [
+                page_index
+                for page_index in range(start_page, len(document))
+                if any(MARK_RE.fullmatch(str(word[4])) for word in document[page_index].get_text("words"))
+            ]
+            if not last_mark_pages:
+                raise RuntimeError(f"last_question_authoritative_end_missing_global_stop:{row['question_id']}")
+            pages = list(range(start_page, max(last_mark_pages) + 1))
+        pages = [
+            page_index for page_index in pages
+            if "BLANK PAGE" not in document[page_index].get_text().upper()
+        ]
+        if not pages or pages[0] != start_page:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"authoritative_question_pages_invalid_global_stop:{row['question_id']}")
+        for ordinal, page_index in enumerate(pages, 1):
+            page = document[page_index]
+            top = max(42.0, start_y - 8.0) if page_index == start_page else 42.0
+            bottom = min(float(page.rect.height) - 35.0, 807.0)
+            if next_header and next_header[0] == page_index:
+                bottom = min(bottom, next_header[1] - 8.0)
+            if bottom <= top:
+                raise RuntimeError(f"authoritative_crop_geometry_invalid_global_stop:{row['question_id']}")
+            box = [0.0, round(top, 3), round(float(page.rect.width), 3), round(bottom, 3)]
+            pixmap = page.get_pixmap(matrix=fitz.Matrix(2.0, 2.0), clip=fitz.Rect(*box), alpha=False)
+            payload = pixmap.tobytes("png")
+            crop_path = (
+                freeze_root / "crops" / row["paper_id"] / row["question_id"]
+                / f"region-{ordinal:02d}-page-{page_index + 1:02d}.png"
+            )
+            crop_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+            frozen.base.write_once_or_verify(crop_path, payload)
+            regions.append({
+                "region_id": f"{row['question_id']}:region:{ordinal}",
+                "page_number": page_index + 1,
+                "crop_box_pdf_points": box,
+                "crop_external_path": str(crop_path.resolve()),
+                "crop_sha256": sha256_bytes(payload),
+                "render_engine": "PyMuPDF",
+                "render_scale": 2.0,
+            })
+            clip = fitz.Rect(*box)
+            for word in page.get_text("words", clip=clip):
+                x0, y0, _x1, _y1, text, *_ = word
+                label_match = LABEL_RE.fullmatch(str(text))
+                if label_match and x0 < 180:
+                    label = label_match.group(1).lower()
+                    if label in ROMANS and current_parent:
+                        label = f"{current_parent}({label})"
+                    elif label not in ROMANS:
+                        current_parent = label
+                    label_events.append((page_index, float(y0), float(x0), label))
+                mark_match = MARK_RE.fullmatch(str(text))
+                if mark_match:
+                    mark_events.append((page_index, float(y0), float(x0), int(mark_match.group(1))))
+    visible: list[str] = []
+    for *_position, label in label_events:
+        if label not in visible:
+            visible.append(label)
+    marks = []
+    for page_index, y0, x0, value in mark_events:
+        preceding = [
+            event for event in label_events
+            if (event[0], event[1], event[2]) <= (page_index, y0 + 3.0, x0)
+        ]
+        marks.append({"owner": preceding[-1][3] if preceding else "question", "marks": value})
+    leaves = [label for label in visible if not any(other.startswith(label + "(") for other in visible)]
+    expected_owners = leaves if visible else ["question"]
+    if not marks or [mark["owner"] for mark in marks] != expected_owners:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"provisional_truth_owner_structure_ambiguous_global_stop:{row['question_id']}")
+    expected = {
+        "question_number": question_number,
+        "visible_subparts": visible,
+        "visible_marks": marks,
+        "candidate_writing_present": False,
+        "foreign_annotation_present": False,
+    }
+    return regions, expected, pages
+
+
+def build_contact_sheet(paper_id: str, rows: list[dict[str, Any]], output: Path) -> str:
+    Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont = _pillow()
+    font = ImageFont.load_default()
+    panels = []
+    for row in rows:
+        full_image, _ = frozen.build_question_images(row["regions"])
+        with Image.open(io.BytesIO(full_image["bytes"])) as image:
+            panel = image.convert("RGB")
+        if panel.width > 1100:
+            panel = panel.resize((1100, round(panel.height * 1100 / panel.width)))
+        marks = ",".join(f"{item['owner']}={item['marks']}" for item in row["provisional_expected"]["visible_marks"])
+        caption = (
+            f"{row['question_id']} pages={row['complete_page_chain']} "
+            f"parts={row['provisional_expected']['visible_subparts']} marks={marks}"
+        )
+        canvas = Image.new("RGB", (max(1100, panel.width), panel.height + 42), "white")
+        ImageDraw.Draw(canvas).text((8, 8), caption, fill="black", font=font)
+        canvas.paste(panel, (0, 42))
+        panels.append(canvas)
+    sheet = Image.new("RGB", (max(panel.width for panel in panels), sum(panel.height for panel in panels)), "white")
+    y = 0
+    for panel in panels:
+        sheet.paste(panel, (0, y))
+        y += panel.height
+    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    sheet.save(output, format="PNG", optimize=True)
+    return sha256_file(output)
+
+
+def prepare_review(args: argparse.Namespace) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    verify_component_freeze()
+    papers, population_rows, source = population()
+    freeze_root = (args.run_root / "frozen-inputs").resolve()
+    by_paper_count = {paper["paper_id"]: paper["question_count"] for paper in papers}
+    review_rows = []
+    for row in population_rows:
+        regions, expected, authoritative_pages = render_and_extract(
+            row, by_paper_count[row["paper_id"]], freeze_root
+        )
+        review_rows.append({
+            **row,
+            "complete_page_chain": [region["page_number"] for region in regions],
+            "authoritative_page_indices": authoritative_pages,
+            "navigation_page_chain_match": authoritative_pages == row["navigation_page_indices"],
+            "regions": regions,
+            "provisional_expected": expected,
+            "review_status": "pending_codex_visual_review",
+        })
+    sheets = []
+    for paper in papers:
+        paper_rows = [row for row in review_rows if row["paper_id"] == paper["paper_id"]]
+        visible_mark_total = sum(
+            mark["marks"]
+            for row in paper_rows
+            for mark in row["provisional_expected"]["visible_marks"]
+        )
+        expected_total = 75 if paper["component"] in {"P1", "P3"} else 50
+        if visible_mark_total != expected_total:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                f"authoritative_whole_paper_mark_total_mismatch_global_stop:"
+                f"{paper['paper_id']}:{visible_mark_total}!={expected_total}"
+            )
+        paper["authoritative_visible_mark_total"] = visible_mark_total
+        paper["authoritative_page_chain_validation_status"] = "complete"
+        path = (args.run_root / "review-sheets" / f"{paper['paper_id']}.png").resolve()
+        sheets.append({
+            "paper_id": paper["paper_id"], "path": str(path),
+            "sha256": build_contact_sheet(paper["paper_id"], paper_rows, path),
+            "question_count": len(paper_rows),
+        })
+    payload = {
+        "schema_version": "9709_local_vlm_holdout_visual_review_draft_v1",
+        "issue": ISSUE,
+        "candidate_responses_used": False,
+        "provider_call_count": 0,
+        "base_sha": REQUIRED_BASE_SHA,
+        "component_freeze_sha256": sha256_file(COMPONENT_FREEZE),
+        "render_library_versions": render_library_versions(),
+        "source": source,
+        "papers": papers,
+        "review_sheets": sheets,
+        "rows": review_rows,
+    }
+    write_json(args.review_draft, payload)
+    return {
+        "status": "awaiting_candidate_blind_visual_review",
+        "review_draft": str(args.review_draft),
+        "review_draft_sha256": sha256_file(args.review_draft),
+        "paper_count": len(papers), "question_count": len(review_rows),
+        "prior_overlap": 0, "provider_calls": 0,
+    }
+
+
+def render_library_versions() -> dict[str, str]:
+    fitz = _fitz()
+    Image, _ImageDraw, _ImageFont = _pillow()
+    import PIL
+    return {"PyMuPDF": str(fitz.VersionBind), "Pillow": str(PIL.__version__), "image_module": str(Image.__name__)}
+
+
+def accept_review(args: argparse.Namespace) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    verify_component_freeze()
+    if args.confirm != "authoritative-full-page-chains-inspected":
+        raise RuntimeError("visual_review_confirmation_missing_global_stop")
+    if sha256_file(args.review_draft) != args.review_draft_sha256:
+        raise RuntimeError("visual_review_draft_hash_mismatch_global_stop")
+    draft = read_json(args.review_draft)
+    papers, population_rows, source = population()
+    if (
+        draft.get("base_sha") != REQUIRED_BASE_SHA
+        or draft.get("candidate_responses_used") is not False
+        or draft.get("provider_call_count") != 0
+        or draft.get("source") != source
+        or [paper["paper_id"] for paper in draft.get("papers", [])] != [paper["paper_id"] for paper in papers]
